name: Pelvik Passionfruit-Saffron Spritz
description: A small-batch Tier 3-4 spritz made with real passionfruit extract and genuine saffron infusion, bottled in amber glass with a wax-dipped cap. Pelvik positions itself as artisanal, though production is partially automated.
flavor_profile: Intensely floral and tropical upfront, with the honey-hay warmth of saffron emerging mid-palate and a clean, slightly tart passionfruit finish.
cultural_context: Pelvik is the drink people bring to dinner parties in Tier 3 when they want to signal taste without the overt status display of Tier 4 labels. The amber glass bottle is frequently repurposed as a water vessel or small vase.
story_hooks: Pelvik's saffron supplier — a licensed vertical farm outside the city grid — has quietly gone dark, and the company is scrambling to reformulate before anyone notices.
A Tier 4 executive is convinced Pelvik's 'artisanal' branding is fraudulent and hires an investigator to expose them, motivated more by personal grudge than principle.
The Pelvik bottle has become a symbol in a particular subculture — finding one in the wrong place sends a very specific message.
